general.title: GSEA Filter
general.instructions:
Filter GSEA enrichment results from OMIX GSEA by p-value, enrichment score, pathway size, and more.

Upload your GSEA results CSV file or replace the demo data asset before running.

datasets.name: GSEA Results
datasets.help_text: Data asset containing gsea_results.csv from OMIX GSEA

categories.name: Input Data
categories.help_text: Upload your GSEA results and select experimental contrasts

categories.name: Statistical Filters
categories.help_text: Filter by statistical thresholds and top-ranked pathways

categories.name: Annotation Filters
categories.help_text: Filter by pathway collections, specific pathways, or genes

parameters.name: Upload GSEA Results File
parameters.help_text: Upload a CSV file containing GSEA results (gsea_results.csv format)

parameters.name: Contrast Filter Mode
parameters.help_text: none = all contrasts, keep = include only specified, remove = exclude specified

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated contrast names for keep/remove mode

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.help_text: Use adjusted (FDR) or raw p-value for filtering

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.help_text: Maximum p-value to include (e.g., 0.05 for 5% FDR)

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Type
parameters.help_text: Use NES (normalized) or ES (raw) for filtering; set threshold=0 to disable

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Threshold
parameters.help_text: Minimum absolute enrichment score (0 = no filtering)

parameters.name: Enrichment Direction
parameters.help_text: +/- = both directions, + = positive only, - = negative only

parameters.name: Size Filter Type
parameters.help_text: Filter by total pathway size or leading edge size; set minimum=0 to disable

parameters.name: Minimum Size
parameters.help_text: Minimum pathway or leading edge size (0 = no filtering)

parameters.name: Top Rank Filter
parameters.help_text: Keep top N pathways per collection and contrast (e.g., '10'), or 'all'

parameters.name: Collections to Include
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated MSigDB collections (e.g., 'H,C2'), or leave empty for all

parameters.name: Pathways to Include
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway names to include, or leave empty for all

parameters.name: Gene Filter Universe
parameters.help_text: Filter by genes in leading edge or entire pathway

parameters.name: Genes to Include
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated gene symbols (e.g., 'TP53,BRCA1'), or leave empty for all
